name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, a new level, enemy, or power-up
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of the problem or idea. Ex. "I wish BombJack had [...]"

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. For a new level,
feel free to sketch it using the schema in `js/levels.js`.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've thought about.

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
